dct_description_sm: This is a georeferenced map of the Districts of Victoria and Esquimalt in Vancouver Island.  [Victoria and Esquimalt Districts, 1854] Published 1854, by John Arrowsmith. 2 inches to 1 mile. Shows lots and owners (if any), First Nations reserves, farms, mills etc.
